J0ta at the tablet

J0ta with his Gaomon tablet lying flat in front of him. His left hand holds the tablet edge, his right hand holds the stylus, and his head nods, tilts and turns on a ball joint. Every piece comes from the sets you listed.

    Pose J0ta
